meta.name: Process invoices securely with OpenAI, Slack, and ERP webhooks

parameters.content:
## 1. Secure Intake & Document Validation

Receives invoices through the webhook and performs initial validation before any downstream processing.

### Responsibilities
• Accept document upload
• Validate supported file types (PDF, PNG, JPG)
• Validate maximum file size
• Verify malware scan status
• Generate Correlation ID
• Preserve binary document
• Create standardized metadata

### Expected Output
✔ Validated document
✔ Metadata
✔ Correlation ID
✔ Source information

Invalid documents are routed directly to the exception queue.

## 6. ERP Posting & Recovery

Posts approved invoices to ERP using idempotent transactions.

### Integration Controls
• Idempotency-Key
• Approved Credentials
• Correlation ID
• Retry Strategy
• Timeout Handling

Production Recommendations
• Retry only 429/5xx
• Exponential Backoff
• Dead Letter Queue
• Reconciliation before retry

□ Replace demo nodes with production OCR/AI services
□ Configure ERP credentials
□ Configure notification credentials
□ Secure webhook authentication
□ Enable retry workflow
□ Enable monitoring
□ Test duplicate scenarios
□ Test low confidence routing
□ Test ERP outage recovery
□ Verify audit logs

## 2. Evidence Store & Duplicate Detection

Ensures the same invoice cannot be processed multiple times.

### Responsibilities
• Generate document fingerprint
• Lookup previous submissions
• Maintain immutable evidence
• Preserve idempotency
• Detect duplicate invoices

Production Recommendation
Replace demo duplicate logic with:
• PostgreSQL UNIQUE(source_sha256)
or
• Redis SETNX

Duplicate invoices bypass processing and enter the review queue.

=You are an Enterprise Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) engine specialized in invoice extraction.

Your responsibility is to accurately extract structured invoice information from OCR text.

Rules:
- Extract only information explicitly present in the document.
- Never hallucinate or fabricate values.
- If a value is not present, return null.
- Return exactly one valid JSON object.
- Do not include markdown, explanations, comments, or code fences.
- Convert dates to ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
- Convert monetary values to numbers (remove currency symbols and commas).
- Convert quantities to integers where applicable.
- Preserve the order of line items.
- Detect vendor, customer, invoice details, payment terms, taxes, totals, and all line items.
- Estimate confidence scores between 0.00 and 1.00 for important extracted fields.

=Extract the following OCR text into a structured invoice JSON.

OCR DOCUMENT

{{ $json.text }}

Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching the schema below.

{
  "document_type": "invoice",

  "vendor": {
    "id": null,
    "name": null,
    "address": null,
    "email": null,
    "phone": null,
    "tax_id": null
  },

  "customer": {
    "name": null,
    "address": null
  },

  "invoice": {
    "number": null,
    "issue_date": null,
    "due_date": null,
    "currency": null,
    "payment_terms": null,
    "purchase_order": null
  },

  "amounts": {
    "subtotal": null,
    "tax": null,
    "discount": null,
    "shipping": null,
    "total": null
  },

  "line_items": [
    {
      "line_no": null,
      "description": null,
      "quantity": null,
      "unit_price": null,
      "amount": null
    }
  ],

  "confidence": {
    "vendor_name": null,
    "invoice_number": null,
    "invoice_date": null,
    "due_date": null,
    "currency": null,
    "subtotal": null,
    "tax": null,
    "total_amount": null
  }
}

Validation Rules

- document_type must always be "invoice".
- Monetary values must be numeric.
- Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD.
- Currency must be the ISO currency code (USD, INR, EUR, etc.).
- If an email or phone number is not present, return null.
- If no discount or shipping charge exists, return 0.
- Do not omit any fields.
- Return only JSON.

## 3. OCR & AI Invoice Extraction

Extracts invoice information using OCR and AI while enforcing structured output.

### AI Extraction
• Vendor
• Customer
• Invoice Details
• Line Items
• Currency
• Tax
• Totals
• Confidence Scores

### AI Controls
• Approved LLM
• Fixed Prompt Version
• JSON Schema Output
• Model Provenance
• Confidence Tracking

Output is validated before ERP integration.

## 5. Human Review & Exception Handling

Routes invoices requiring manual verification before ERP posting.

### Review Triggers
• Low AI confidence
• Validation failures
• Duplicate documents
• Invalid intake
• ERP retry exhaustion

### Reviewer Actions
✔ Approve
✔ Reject
✔ Add Correction Reason
✔ Capture Reviewer ID

All review actions are fully audited.

## 4. Business Validation Engine

Validates extracted invoice data using deterministic business rules.

### Validation Rules
• Vendor Exists
• Invoice Number
• Invoice Date
• Due Date
• Currency
• Tax
• Total Amount
• Line Items
• Confidence Threshold

Each failure produces a standardized validation code.

Examples
VAL-01 Vendor Missing
VAL-03 Invoice Number Missing
VAL-09 Invalid Total
VAL-13 Low Confidence

## 7. Audit Logging & Compliance

Creates a sanitized audit trail without storing document contents.

Captured Information
• Correlation ID
• Processing Status
• Validation Result
• Duplicate Status
• Review Decision
• ERP Posting Result
• AI Model Version

Supports compliance, troubleshooting, and traceability.

# Intelligent Invoice Processing Workflow

## Purpose

This workflow automates the complete invoice processing lifecycle by securely ingesting invoices, extracting structured information using AI, validating business rules, routing exceptions for human review, and posting approved invoices to the ERP system.

The solution minimizes manual effort, reduces processing time, prevents duplicate invoice creation, and maintains a complete audit trail for compliance and operational transparency.

---

## Business Objectives

• Automate invoice processing from document upload to ERP posting.
• Eliminate duplicate invoice processing using immutable evidence.
• Improve extraction accuracy through AI-assisted document understanding.
• Enforce deterministic business validation before ERP integration.
• Enable Human-in-the-Loop review for low-confidence or exceptional cases.
• Maintain secure, traceable, and auditable processing.
• Ensure reliable ERP integration using idempotent requests and recovery mechanisms.

---

## Expected Outcome
✔ Faster invoice processing
✔ Reduced manual intervention
✔ Higher extraction accuracy
✔ Controlled exception handling
✔ Complete auditability
✔ Enterprise-ready document processing

# Workflow Operation Guide

## Step 1 – Configure Credentials

Before execution, configure:

• AI Model Credentials
• ERP API Credentials
• Slack / Teams Notification Credentials
• Database Credentials
• Storage Credentials (if applicable)

---

## Step 2 – Submit Invoice

Send an invoice using the webhook endpoint.

Supported formats:
• PDF
• PNG
• JPG

The workflow automatically validates the uploaded document.

---

## Step 3 – Automated Processing

The workflow automatically performs:

• Intake Validation
• Duplicate Detection
• OCR Extraction
• AI Data Extraction
• Business Validation

No manual intervention is required during this stage.

---

## Step 4 – Human Review (If Required)

Invoices are routed to the review queue when:

• AI confidence is below threshold
• Validation rules fail
• Duplicate documents are detected
• Intake validation fails

The reviewer can:

✔ Approve
✔ Reject
✔ Provide correction reason
✔ Record reviewer comments

---

## Step 5 – ERP Posting

Approved invoices are posted to the ERP system using an idempotent API request.
Successful posting generates an audit record.

---

## Step 6 – Audit & Monitoring

After completion the workflow stores:

• Correlation ID
• Processing Status
• Validation Result
• Review Decision
• ERP Response
• Processing Timestamp
• AI Model Information

These records support monitoring, troubleshooting, and compliance reporting.
